BiblicalUsage: Chammah is the heat of the sun itself, and Scripture sets it beside God's glory. The sun shall be ashamed when the LORD of hosts reigns in Zion, and in the day He binds up His people's breach the light of the sun shall be sevenfold. Job went mourning without the sun, and the psalm says of the sun's circuit that there is nothing hid from its heat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sun is the one light no one can hide from, and that is why the prophets use it to picture God's day. Its heat finds everything, and so will His reign. I hold that the same sun that scorches a mourning Job will one day shine sevenfold on a healed people.
